mainEntity.name: Where is Astra Dental Centre located?

acceptedAnswer.text: Astra Dental Centre is located at Unit 120, 20061 Fraser Hwy, Langley, BC. The parkade entrance is behind the building, accessible from 20058 Industrial Ave.
We are open Monday and Friday from 10:00 AM to 7:00 PM, Tuesday through Thursday and Saturday from 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM, and closed on Sunday.
Yes, we welcome new patients and families from Langley and across the Fraser Valley.

mainEntity.name: Do you offer direct billing and accept the CDCP?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, we provide direct billing to all major insurers and accept the Canadian Dental Care Plan (CDCP).

mainEntity.name: Do you offer Invisalign and same-day crowns?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Dr. Potluri is a certified Invisalign provider and we offer same-day CEREC crowns, so many restorations can be completed in a single visit.
